desc:
A multiple-scenario game inspired by Sericulture, Cyberpunk, SS13, and other titles.
Double XP on Weekends

TAB: character info
C: action log
B: inventory
G: stash item to inventory
Y: drop item
1-2-3 button while holding item/hovering over item in inventory = bind to hotbar
Z: enable/disable combat mode
T: rack gun
F with mouse on body/ragdolled player: drag
P: take off gloves/hats
Click while dragging alive enemy to subdue them
Click while dragging a KOd teammate to do CPR
Middle Mouse Button = Ping
Q/E: lean
switch arm: left alt

thumbnail : Dess
billboard art : Dess, ChillZoh, KeenlyAware, hypersnyperzalt2

SFX & Art : com_padree

maps by : owqn, ChillZoh, tuu0334
cyberpunk gun models by : DonovanL2011
animations by : WizOr8, 55Epa
original game concept & inspiration : Sericulture by flowerofthewise
This game includes randomized rewards (accessories). All odds are shown in-game.
